vis.scope: One MeasurementSet; lists with more than one MS are refused (#54/#980).

selectdata.scope: Read then ignored; CASA task selection fields are applied regardless of this flag.

field.scope: Empty becomes no field; IDs/ranges pass; alphabetic names and * are refused (issue 980).

spw.scope: Copied as spectral-window/channel selector; selected-channel derived cube extents are refused in limited nchan/start/width cases (issue 980).

timerange.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

uvrange.scope: Copied as CASA selector text to request.

antenna.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

scan.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

observation.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

intent.scope: Copied as CASA selector text to request.

datacolumn.scope: data/observed maps to DATA; corrected maps to automatic CORRECTED_DATA else DATA; other strings refused.

imagename.scope: A fresh output namespace only. Existing scientific products in the main or outlier namespace are refused before execution (#944); continuation and restart=False numbering are unfinished.

imsize.scope: Positive even scalar/one/two dimensions; non-square standard/W/mosaic is implemented (#970). Odd dimensions are refused; AW requires square images and equal cells.

cell.scope: Scalar/one/two quantities or numeric arcseconds; empty is refused as in CASA. Unequal axes are implemented outside AW (#970).

phasecenter.scope: Numeric text is split into phasecenter_field; other text becomes phasecenter direction; empty means unset.

stokes.scope: Native Stokes/correlation coordinates; full-Stokes and basis-dependent combinations require their own acceptance, not an I-plane inference.

projection.scope: Read and ignored; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

startmodel.scope: One real Jy/pixel model, MFS or cube, with matching Stokes/spectral axes and direction frame; masked pixels become zero; linear flux-preserving reprojection. MT-MFS and outlier combinations are refused. See #970 and the existing Stokes-mismatch deviation.

specmode.scope: cont aliases mfs; mvc is refused (issue 823); cube, cubedata and cubesource pass into request/spectral compile.

reffreq.scope: Read and ignored by reader; catalog refuses non-default in every mode (issue 980).

nchan.scope: In cube, positive value supplies output count; -1 uses casa-rs channel_count. MFS ignores this count. Derived CASA extent cases are refused (issue 980).

start.scope: MFS ignores it; cube copies text. A channel-subset spw without explicit start is refused; some nchan=-1 derived extents are refused (issue 980).

width.scope: MFS ignores it; cube copies text. Some nchan=-1 derived extents are refused (issue 980).

outframe.scope: MFS only accepts CASA default LSRK; cube accepts LSRK/BARY/TOPO/REST case-insensitively and uppercases; other frames refused (issue 980).

veltype.scope: MFS ignores it; cube maps radio->RADIO, optical/z->OPTICAL, beta/relativistic/true->BETA; other values refused (issue 980).

restfreq.scope: MFS requires empty; cube accepts zero or one frequency; multiple rest frequencies refused (issue 980).

interpolation.scope: MFS ignores it; cube forwards it except cubic, which is refused (issue 823).

gridder.scope: Aliases standard/ft/gridft, W aliases, and mosaic aliases normalize; awproject accepted; awprojectft and other unsupported families refused (issue 980).

facets.scope: Standard gridder passes count; mosaic rejects count != 1 as CASA does; W/AW count != 1 refused pending support (issue 980).

psfphasecenter.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for mosaic/mosaicft/ftmosaic (issue 980).

wprojplanes.scope: W/AW: -1 becomes derive/None and positive counts pass; non-positive other than -1 refused. W aliases with one plane normalize to standard. Ignored by other gridders.

vptable.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for listed non-AW gridder families (issue 980).

mosweight.scope: True with density weighting and gridder exactly mosaic is refused (issue 818); otherwise not mapped into request.

aterm.scope: Read; AW requires true, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

psterm.scope: Read; AW requires false, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

wbawp.scope: Read; AW requires true, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

conjbeams.scope: Read; AW requires true and mosaic requires false; other gridders ignore it; incompatible values refused (issue 980).

cfcache.scope: AW with default CASA-import cache requires non-empty path and passes it; otherwise ignored.

usepointing.scope: Copied only for mosaic/AW; read and ignored for standard/W.

computepastep.scope: Read and ignored; non-default values catalog-refused for applicable AW families (issue 980).

rotatepastep.scope: Read and ignored; non-default values catalog-refused for applicable AW families (issue 980).

pointingoffsetsigdev.scope: Scalar/list numbers converted to comma text for AW; otherwise ignored.

pblimit.scope: Copied; request requires non-zero magnitude below 1.

normtype.scope: Passed only to mosaic/AW; pbsquare refused (issue 823); other gridders ignore it.

deconvolver.scope: hogbom/clark/multiscale/mtmfs pass; asp refused with issue 223; other CASA algorithms refused with issue 823.

scales.scope: Number list; forwarded only for multiscale/mtmfs, otherwise normalized to none; request disallows negative scales.

nterms.scope: Used only by mtmfs; other deconvolvers force one. mtmfs nterms=1 refused (issue 980); request enforces >1 exactly for mtmfs.

fusedthreshold.scope: Ignored outside ASP, as CASA ignores it. ASP is refused (#223); no ASP implementation is claimed.

largestscale.scope: Ignored outside ASP, as CASA ignores it. ASP is refused (#223); no ASP implementation is claimed.

restoringbeam.scope: Empty -> none; common -> common; explicit axes/angle form refused pending support (issue 980).

pbcor.scope: Copied; determines primary-beam-corrected product/beam behavior downstream.

outlierfile.scope: Native outlier fields, natural weighting, dirty or Hogbom; each outlier currently has standard single-term MFS defaults. Per-field differing modes, start models and spectral controls are restricted by the existing parser.

weighting.scope: natural/uniform/briggs/briggsbwtaper accepted; unsupported weighting modes refused (issue 980); briggsbwtaper with MFS refused as CASA does.

noise.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused when weighting=briggsabs (issue 980); briggsabs itself is not implemented.

npixels.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for non-natural weighting (issue 980).

uvtaper.scope: Unit-bearing circular/elliptical angles or lambda/klambda; one/two/three entries. Missing-unit values are refused instead of reproducing CASA's radians-versus-documented-lambda behavior (#970).

niter.scope: Copied to request as total minor-cycle iterations.

threshold.scope: Copied; request interprets quantity in Jy/beam; return record echoes original number/text for dirty runs.

cycleniter.scope: CASA correction: <=0 or >niter becomes niter (at least 1); maps to minor_cycle_length.

interactive.scope: Read and ignored by request; non-default catalog-refused (issue 980), since interactive viewer path is unsupported.

nmajor.scope: Copied; -1 -> no limit; niter>0 with nmajor=0 refused (issue 980).

fullsummary.scope: Long-form keys exist, but missing measurements and per-plane values are NaN. Return shape alone is not return-value equivalence.

usemask.scope: user and auto-multithresh pass; pb refused (issue 823); controls whether user mask is read.

mask.scope: One image or CRTF pixel boxes, including a region file. General CRTF shapes, multiple mask images and CASA clipping of out-of-grid boxes remain gaps.

sidelobethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

noisethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

lownoisethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

negativethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

smoothfactor.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

minbeamfrac.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

cutthreshold.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

growiterations.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

dogrowprune.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

minpercentchange.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

verbose.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

restart.scope: Fresh output namespaces only. Sequential reruns with existing products are explicitly refused until continuation and numbering are implemented (#944).

savemodel.scope: Copied; virtual refused (issue 823); modelcolumn writes MODEL_DATA and request checks a solved or start model exists.

parallel.scope: Native local worker resource policy, not CASA MPI launch/partition semantics. Ordinary output equivalence and resource bounds require separate evidence; distributed behavior is unfinished.

behaviors.title: Selection and multi-MS inputs
behaviors.scope: vis, field, spw, timerange, uvrange, antenna, scan, observation, intent, datacolumn and selectdata (#54).
behaviors.gap: IDs/ranges, SPW/channel text, intent and UV limits are routed natively. Multi-MS, field names/patterns and four row selectors are refused. Prove selected MAIN row identities/order, flags, channel membership and data-column fallback before image comparison; do not infer selection equivalence from a plausible image.

behaviors.title: Restart, product persistence and recalculation
behaviors.scope: imagename, restart, startmodel, calcres, calcpsf, restoration; main and outlier fields (#944).
behaviors.gap: CASA restart=True continues the existing model and checks compatible image shape/coordinates; explicit startmodel conflicts with an existing model. restart=False preserves old products and chooses the shared next numbered prefix (bare products count as 1, so first suffix is _2). casa-rs now refuses occupied scientific namespaces before execution; false/recalculation controls are still default-only. This safeguard is unfinished work, not an agreed final deviation. Concurrent jobs targeting one prefix remain unassessed.

behaviors.title: Cube axes, reference frequencies and moving sources
behaviors.scope: specmode, spw, start, width, nchan, reffreq, restfreq, outframe, veltype, interpolation and perchanweightdensity.
behaviors.gap: Cube channel-count mapping exists, but selected-channel-derived defaults are refused; MFS frame/rest-frequency forms, multiple rest frequencies and cubic interpolation remain restricted. Moving-source cubesource needs its own representative oracle (#714). MVC removal is a separate prior owner decision, not a passing moving-source comparison.

behaviors.title: Gridder, weighting and beam combinations
behaviors.scope: standard/W/mosaic/AW, rectangular geometry, facets, normtype, beam terms and density weighting.
behaviors.gap: Rectangular standard/W/mosaic and uvtaper were implemented in #970. AW remains square/equal-cell, MFS-only, with fixed A/WB/conjugate terms and no PS term. Mosaic per-field density weighting is refused (#818); W/AW facets and additional gridders/weightings are incomplete. A native CF path is required; importing a CASA oracle cache is not proof of general native AW equivalence.

behaviors.title: Deconvolution, masks and stopping
behaviors.scope: Hogbom, Clark, multiscale, MT-MFS, iteration controls, user masks and auto-multithresh.
behaviors.gap: ASP, MEM, Clark-Stokes, MT-MFS nterms=1, PB masks/pbsquare, several auto-mask controls, explicit restoring beams and nmajor=0 are incomplete or refused. Compare convergence/flux/beam and exact mask support separately; nonlinear component identity is not required, but approved mode-specific gates stay binding.

behaviors.title: Return values, exceptions and metadata
behaviors.scope: Python and CLI CASA return record, output topology, coordinates, beams, mask validity, model-column effects and reopen.
behaviors.gap: The recorded 22-key structure exists. maxpsfsidelobe, dirty peak, outside-mask peaks, next cyclethreshold, seeded fluxes and multi-plane summary values are not fully measured and are NaN. Errors/refusal types and valid-but-unsupported combinations need paired checks. Existing return-structure recordings contain no numeric acceptance. Persistence requires independent CASA reopen and native reopen.

behaviors.title: Precision, backend and resource acceptance
behaviors.scope: backend=auto/cpu/gpu, gridprecision and all scientific products (#991).
behaviors.gap: Auto may select Metal/f32. #991 reported compact-array PSF NRMS about 0.019, with f64 CPU about 7.4e-8, against older CASA 6.7.5. Reproduce with 6.7.6.14; the old f32 decision does not automatically approve this larger error. Do not widen tolerances or substitute worker/GPU results for required serial acceptance. Preserve memory admissions, native computation and per-mode performance requirements.

decisions.inputs: interactive=True; graphical mask editing and pause/resume.
decisions.casa: Uses casaviewer where available; 6.7.6.14 on macOS raises when the viewer is absent.
decisions.ours: Refuses interactive=True explicitly; accepts False. Supply a mask or use supported auto-multithresh controls.
decisions.rationale: The application is headless; the owner accepted the exception for the current phase.
decisions.impact: No graphical mask editing/pause-resume. Future interactive operation remains wanted, not permanently out of scope.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner, 2026-10-31, this chat: Headless exception for now, but ultimately we will want to do something for this. Recorded on #980.

decisions.ours: Refuses MVC; cubesource is the surviving moving-source path.
decisions.rationale: Reuse owner decision B on #656, reflected in #714; do not revive a deleted mode without a new decision.
decisions.impact: MVC workflows are unavailable; cubesource representative acceptance remains unfinished.
decisions.owner_decision: Decision B on #656; #714 non-goal: no MVC revival.

decisions.inputs: Any occupied main/outlier image namespace; restart=False or recalculation controls.
decisions.casa: Continues existing products by default, or chooses a numbered fresh prefix with restart=False.
decisions.ours: Refuses occupied scientific namespaces before execution; non-default restart/calcres/calcpsf still refused.
decisions.rationale: Prevent silent destruction while implementing the actual lifecycle.
decisions.impact: Repeat imaging must temporarily use a new imagename; this cannot be counted as complete restart support.

decisions.inputs: Unitless uvtaper or startmodel with a different Stokes coordinate.
decisions.casa: Unitless taper is interpreted as radians despite documented lambda; its startmodel regrid can copy a different single Stokes plane.
decisions.ours: Refuses those inputs, as recorded by #970 and the CASA bugs reference.
decisions.rationale: Avoid zero-weight images and mislabeled polarization. Verify the exact inherited owner-agreement scope before counting these as accepted deviations.
decisions.impact: Explicit taper units and matching model Stokes are required. Merging the implementation alone is not proof of an owner-approved exception.

signature.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 names/defaults/XML domains only; not scientific behavior.

reader.scope: Runtime mapping, reader refusals, typed validation, availability, publication preflight and summary gaps at the audit baseline plus this bounded work. Source/test definitions do not establish executed acceptance.

returns.scope: Four CASA cases: dirty, CLEAN, fullsummary and cube. Values are deliberately not recorded; numeric summaries remain unverified.

additions.scope: Merged #970 reports CASA 6.7.6.14 against 75ec3c9c5d: rectangular geometry, taper and scoped start models; exact mask agreement and sumwt, per-product NRMS/beam measurements. This is scoped historical evidence, not a current full-task pass.

representative.scope: Reuse the representative-science matrix and applicable identity-bound receipts. T1/T1.5/T2/resource/persistence tiers and approved per-mode limits stay distinct; no blanket current pass is claimed.

lifecycle.kind: Paired lifecycle probe and refusal regression
lifecycle.scope: Planned fresh CASA 6.7.6.14 continuation, numbering and startmodel-conflict probes; native sequential rerun/outlier refusal must preserve previous bytes. This does not establish implemented restart.

mvc-decision.scope: Owner decision B on #656 removed MVC. #714 explicitly excludes MVC revival and requires a cubesource representative row; reuse only this scope.

accuracy-issue.scope: #991 measurements use CASA 6.7.5 and 8b35089888; they identify a gap rather than current 6.7.6.14 acceptance.

interactive-decision.scope: Owner in this chat, 2026-10-31: "Headless exception for now, but ultimately we will want to do something for this." Revisit interactive operation later; preserve explicit refusal now.
